# SignalLab — revised demonstration

Current delivered video: [Watch v2](demo.html) · [Narration transcript](media/demo-transcript-v2.md).

Duration: approximately 2 minutes 45 seconds. 18 shots, faster neural English narration with pitch-preserving tempo adjustment, UI detail crops, policy comparisons, calculation graphics and on-screen captions. Actual interface captures are combined with illustrative graphics. The MP4 is not continuous screen recording or learner-study footage.

The first cut is retained as `media/signallab-demo.mp4`. Current playback uses `media/signallab-demo-v2.mp4`.

The reproducible video build is `scripts/build-demo-v2.py`, using captures under `assets/demo-v2`. It requires Python packages Pillow and edge-tts, ffmpeg/ffprobe, an internet connection for neural narration, and the macOS Arial font path configured in the script.

Software values shown are the authored fixture results. Peer testing, lecture alignment and optional lecturer review are still pending.
